summary: Tesla runs its own careers system on tesla.com behind Akamai bot protection, which returns 403 Access Denied to automated clients, so no supported method can read it without getting around bot protection.
how_it_works: The careers search page (https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/?query=intern) loads its listings from Tesla's internal endpoint https://www.tesla.com/cua-api/apps/careers/state, which returns JSON holding all listings and lookup tables for location and department. A browser would fetch it and filter listings by title keyword. Akamai blocks that endpoint and the page for automated clients, so it is only reachable from a real, unflagged browser session. Tesla doesn't use Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workday or another third-party job board.
evidence: Automatic inspection with headless Chromium got HTTP 403 with page title 'Access Denied' and no API requests or job links. WebFetch of https://www.tesla.com/cua-api/apps/careers/state also returned 403. Greenhouse board 'tesla' reset the connection, and Ashby and Lever 'tesla' returned 404. Bash wasn't available in this session, so I couldn't try curl or scripts/test_method.py.

summary: Fortinet uses Oracle Recruiting Cloud (HCM Candidate Experience), which has a public JSON search API with a total count, but no supported method handles it; the browser methods can't work because the page loads results 25 at a time through a 'Show more results' button rather than URL pages.
how_it_works: GET https://edel.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions?onlyData=true&expand=requisitionList.secondaryLocations&finder=findReqs;siteNumber=CX_2001,limit=25,offset=N,locationId=300000000361286,sortBy=POSTING_DATES_DESC and page with offset until items[0].requisitionList is empty or offset >= items[0].TotalJobsCount. Each job has Id, Title, PrimaryLocation, PostedDate; the job URL is https://edel.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_2001/job/{Id}. Params: host, site_number, optional keyword and location_id.
evidence: The careers page calls hcmRestApi/CandidateExperience endpoints on edel.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com. Calling the requisitions finder with curl, without logging in, returned TotalJobsCount 545 for keyword=intern, and the LOCATIONS facet lists Canada (Id 300000000361286) with 144 jobs. The browser methods don't click 'Show more results', so they would only ever get the first 25.

summary: onsemi uses Oracle Recruiting Cloud (Candidate Experience site CX_1001), which has a public JSON search API with a total, but no supported method covers it, and the browser methods are unreliable because the Oracle page renders its job list and '7 OPEN JOBS' total 3-5 seconds after the network goes idle.
how_it_works: GET https://{host}/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions?onlyData=true&expand=requisitionList&finder=findReqs;siteNumber={site},selectedLocationsFacet={location_id},limit=25,offset={n} (URL-encode the finder value). items[0].TotalJobsCount is the total; items[0].requisitionList[] has Id, Title, PrimaryLocation, PostedDate. Page by offset += 25 until offset >= TotalJobsCount. Job URL: https://{host}/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/{site}/job/{Id}. Params for onsemi: host=hctz.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com, site=CX_1001, selectedLocationsFacet=300000000341944 (Canada). A small fixed wait (~6s) or wait_for_selector on job links in the browser methods would also fix the browser approach.
evidence: curl of the API with selectedLocationsFacet=300000000341944 returned HTTP 200 JSON with TotalJobsCount 7 (e.g. Id 2506170 'Digital IC Designer'). Rendering the Canada page with the project's own load() showed body text of 753/1014 chars with 0 job links at ~0.6s and ~2.7s, and 7 job links plus '7 OPEN JOBS' only at ~4.8s. browser_paginated with total_regex therefore failed ('total_regex didn't match the first page'), and re-testing browser_page in attempt 3 failed: scrape 1 returned 0 jobs while scrape 2 returned 7.

summary: Sinclair Technologies posts jobs on ADP Workforce Now (cid 5b36c411-2caf-42bb-add4-63afc8e7706c, ccId 9200693907439_2), which no supported method handles; browser_page on the ADP page read 0 jobs because listings are not anchor links.
how_it_works: GET https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/careercenter/public/events/staffing/v1/job-requisitions?cid=CID&ccId=CCID&lang=en_CA&locale=en_CA&$top=50 (page with $skip). The response has meta.totalNumber and jobRequisitions[] with requisitionTitle, itemID, postDate and requisitionLocations[].nameCode.shortName. Job URL: https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?cid=CID&ccId=CCID&lang=en_CA&jobId=EXTERNAL_JOB_ID (ExternalJobID from customFieldGroup.stringFields) or itemID. Params: cid, ccId.
evidence: norsat.com/pages/careers links the Sinclair section to the ADP URL with ccId=9200693907439_2 (the other ccId 9200686826445_2 is Norsat). curl of the public API with no login returned totalNumber 7: Fabricator, Manufacturing Engineer, Production Staff, Planner Junior, Financial Accountant, Accounts Receivable Specialist, Logistics Specialist Junior, all in Aurora, ON, CA. browser_page on the ADP recruitment page found 0 jobs.

summary: Tesla runs its own in-house applicant tracking system behind bot protection, which returns 403 Access Denied to automated clients. None of the supported methods can reach it without bypassing that protection.
how_it_works: Tesla's careers page (tesla.com/careers/search) loads listings from Tesla's own internal API under tesla.com/cua-api. That API is not Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or Workday. Both the page and the API return 403 to non-browser requests. Check Tesla internships in Canada by hand, or use an aggregator that is allowed to republish Tesla listings.
evidence: Automatic inspection got HTTP 403 with the page title 'Access Denied' and no links or API requests. curl with a browser User-Agent got 403 for both /careers/search/?query=intern and /cua-api/apps/careers/state. The Greenhouse, Ashby, and Lever boards named 'tesla' all return 404. Reporting says Tesla built its own HR and applicant tracking software (driveteslacanada.ca/?p=55675), and Tesla has posted jobs for engineers to build its in-house applicant tracking system.
